signal_quality_gate.policy: Directional signals remain blocked until AI validation beats the majority baseline, macro-F1 is >=30, shadow sample >=30 and passes its validation, and a >=300-candle cost-aware holdout backtest is positive.
signal_quality_gate.note: This is a conservative evidence gate, not proof of future profitability.
